Lena Ortiz: Hey team  first day here (Lena, AE). I don't see HubSpot or Gong in my app list and I can't open the AE quick-start in Drive. Need seats and the short checklist before my shadow tomorrow. Who should I tag?

IT Provisioning: Welcome Lena! Please paste this into the IT portal or use the quick-provision form:
```
product: Sales tools
requester: Lena Ortiz
email: lena.ortiz@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (full), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-QuickStart-2024
priority: high
needed-by: 2024-07-05
```
Reply with the ticket ID and we'll triage.

Lena Ortiz: Filed as REQ-7233. Thanks! My shadow is tomorrow at 10am so appreciate the fast help.

Theo (sales ops): Hey Lena  welcome! Canonical quick-start is /Sales/Playbooks/AE-QuickStart-2024. Short items: "Discovery 6Q" (one-pager), "3 Objections" (one-pager), and the 12-min Gong intro. I'll add you to the Drive and drop the one-pagers to your Drive now.

Mira (CS): If you want a sandbox lead to practice logging handoffs, I can create one once HubSpot is live. Also FYI the CS handoff template is Playbooks/Templates/CS-Handoff.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Lena Ortiz! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/lena_ortiz_1747200001. Tasks added: Accept HubSpot invite, Watch Gong intro, Shadow with Theo, Practice sandbox lead logging.

IT Provisioning: REQ-7233 updated: HubSpot seat granted, Gong invite sent via SSO. Check lena.ortiz@redwood.example inbox and accept. If you hit a 403 reply with a screenshot and we'll remap.

Lena Ortiz: Invites received and accepted. I can open the playbook and downloaded the one-pagers. Gong login works too. Thanks for the quick turnaround. See you at the shadow tomorrow. :tada:
